summary: The registrant (Kandal M Venture Ltd) filed a Form 6-K announcing the departure of CFO Kwok Yi Feng effective May 25, 2026, and the appointment of Lam Tai Mau as financial controller (same scope as former CFO) effective May 11, 2026. No change-of-control transaction, compensation terms, or advisor named. The filing is a foreign private issuer report mapping to Item 5.02 of Form 8-K in US practice. The move appears routine succession with no break fee, premium, or shareholder vote. Watch for any future material operational or strategic shifts tied to the finance function change.
